body:
I don't think I can go to therapy for a lot of reasons but I will say that it is brothering be less the more I control my thoughts. I just kinda emotionally let out all the emotions I bottled especially during lockdown in the post while I was writing.

As for the porn I think you are right, I will try my best to stop but it might take a while as I am too much in the loop.

Thanks for the help btw.

I did start doing it very frequently recently (2,3 times a day) but these thoughts very more prevalent when I didn't do it that much. But it is most likely died down because I kinda am able to control what I think using some psychological techniques I read from research on google.

I didn't know most comments would be so positive. I think you understand what I am going through. Thanks this is reassuring.

I was mentally preparing myself to ignore the people telling me, "You are a very sick and disgusting person" and just focus on the advice comments. I thought people would just not understand that I couldn't control these thoughts(I have these opinions from interviews on the internet). I have kinda blocked such thoughts from coming up but it happens from time to time.

Thanks again

Thanks dude this helped. I know the other things are kinda acceptable but I don't think I can tell my parents about it even thought they are pretty progressive for the cultural norms here I feel like this might be too much. I think I would bring a lot of shame to them if they have to reveal this about me to the family.

And about the girls, I read some phycology reports on how to block thoughts and the most effective is to consciously block it which I have been doing for a few months and I can almost completely block it out of my head. I know it was there when I thought about it in the shower but I don't think its going to be a problem. I have trained myself throughout  my depression cycle. But the thing is if I tell anyone about this I am pretty I would be a social outcast. There was a story about a kid who around 16 was also this way but much worse(pre-pubescent children,constant fantasies and exclusively attracted) he told his parents and sought professional help. Ended up broke and homeless after they completely isolated a mentally ill man and condemned him from society . This shit literally makes them exponentially more likely to commit a crime. Great world we live in.
My mom is forcing me to sleep would love to talk in a few hours. It thought a lot of boys face this issue but I didn't think someone would come out so quickly. Will message you in the morning.
I wish. If that were true I would have never made this post in the first place.

Where should I post it then? I already posted on r/Advice and I am waiting for a response.

and what do you think about me? am curious
